title: Chikari
description: A chikari (drone-string) definition. CANONICAL form is {fundamental, uniqueId} only — its drone pitches are NOT serialized. PROP-3: on canonical load, `pitches` is left EMPTY on both sides (no 12-TET default synthesized); the audible drone tuning is owned by the raga (Piece.chikariFreqs -> raga.chikariPitches). Legacy data may include a `pitches` array (preserved on read). TS and Python agree.

fundamental.description: Center-sa frequency (Hz) applied to the drone pitches.

pitches.description: LEGACY ONLY — omitted in canonical form (reconstructed from defaults).
